_readme: Agent registry for the clean/migrate skill. ONE agent is processed at a time. The active agent is chosen by the user; default is workbuddy. Paths use $USERPROFILE$, $LOCALAPPDATA$, $APPDATA$ tokens resolved at runtime. Adding a new agent = adding one entry here, no script rewrite needed for scanning.
_rules: Only one agent per run. Never scan or stage several agents at once - it confuses both the agent and the user.
Default agent is workbuddy. Switch to another only when the user explicitly names it.

Stage/Migrate scripts only implement the delete/move allowlist for 'workbuddy' today. For other agents, use Scan-Agent.ps1 to produce the report and follow that agent's manual_* notes; do not blindly reuse the workbuddy allowlist.
Each agent has a different layout. deletable = safe auto-rebuild caches. migratable = idle data dirs. protected = must never touch. Verify against the real machine before acting.

workbuddy.label: 腾讯 WorkBuddy
workbuddy.default_storage_note: WorkBuddy data root is fixed at ~/.workbuddy. It cannot be relocated by config; a directory junction is the only workaround. Remind the user: after migrating, reset each app's own download/output/cache folder (if configurable) to another drive so C: does not grow again.
workbuddy.manual_delete_note: Stage-LowRisk.ps1 and Migrate-Projects.ps1 implement the full delete/migrate allowlist for this agent.

codex.label: OpenAI Codex
codex.default_storage_note: After cleaning, remind the user to set CODEX_HOME / session and cache output paths to another drive if their Codex build supports it. Do not assume; ask the user to confirm where Codex stores new data.
codex.manual_delete_note: No dedicated allowlist script yet. Use Scan-Agent.ps1 report; stage only user-confirmed deletable paths via copy-then-manual-delete, never touch sessions/skills/plugins/sqlite/auth.

box-agent.label: Box Agent
box-agent.default_storage_note: Remind the user to point Box Agent's runtime/cache and browser download folders to another drive if configurable.
box-agent.manual_delete_note: Runtime is 1+ GB and protected. Only log dir is Standard; browsers is Maximum (login state).

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.default_storage_note: Remind the user to set any Claude config path / cache location to another drive if configurable.
claude.manual_delete_note: Small footprint; verify actual layout before acting - this entry is a template, not measured.

gemini.label: Gemini CLI
gemini.default_storage_note: Remind the user to set GEMINI_CLI_HOME / cache dir to another drive if configurable.
gemini.manual_delete_note: Small footprint; verify actual layout before acting - this entry is a template, not measured.
